description: Defines the IHdmiCecSink interface and related structures for HDMI CEC Sink functionality, including event notifications, device management, and control methods.

classes.name: IHdmiCecSink
classes.description: Interface for HDMI CEC Sink operations and device management.

classes.name: IHdmiCecSink::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for HDMI CEC Sink events.

classes.name: HdmiCecSinkActivePath
classes.description: Structure representing an active HDMI CEC route.

classes.name: HdmiCecSinkDevices
classes.description: Structure representing a connected HDMI device.

classes.name: HdmiCecSinkSuccess
classes.description: Structure indicating success status of operations.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for HDMI CEC Sink events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the HDMI CEC Sink with the given service.

methods.name: GetActiveRoute
methods.description: Retrieves the current active HDMI CEC route.

methods.name: GetActiveSource
methods.description: Retrieves the current active source device information.

methods.name: GetAudioDeviceConnectedStatus
methods.description: Checks if an audio device is connected.

methods.name: GetDeviceList
methods.description: Gets the list of connected HDMI devices.

methods.name: GetEnabled
methods.description: Checks if HDMI CEC Sink is enabled.

methods.name: GetOSDName
methods.description: Retrieves the OSD name of the HDMI CEC Sink.

methods.name: GetVendorId
methods.description: Retrieves the vendor ID of the HDMI CEC Sink.

methods.name: PrintDeviceList
methods.description: Prints the list of connected devices for debugging.

methods.name: RequestActiveSource
methods.description: Requests the active source device.

methods.name: RequestShortAudioDescriptor
methods.description: Requests the Short Audio Descriptor from the device.

methods.name: SendAudioDevicePowerOnMessage
methods.description: Sends a power-on message to the audio device.

methods.name: SendGetAudioStatusMessage
methods.description: Requests the current audio status.

methods.name: SendKeyPressEvent
methods.description: Sends a key press event to a device.

methods.name: SendUserControlPressed
methods.description: Sends a user control pressed message.

methods.name: SendUserControlReleased
methods.description: Sends a user control released message.

methods.name: SendStandbyMessage
methods.description: Sends a standby message to a device.

methods.name: SetActivePath
methods.description: Sets the active HDMI path.

methods.name: SetActiveSource
methods.description: Sets the current device as active source.

methods.name: SetEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables HDMI CEC Sink.

methods.name: SetMenuLanguage
methods.description: Sets the menu language and broadcasts the message.

methods.name: SetOSDName
methods.description: Sets the OSD name of the device.

methods.name: SetRoutingChange
methods.description: Changes HDMI routing between ports.

methods.name: SetupARCRouting
methods.description: Enables or disables ARC routing.

methods.name: SetVendorId
methods.description: Sets the vendor ID.

methods.name: SetLatencyInfo
methods.description: Updates latency and lip sync info.

methods.name: RequestAudioDevicePowerStatus
methods.description: Requests the power status of the audio device.
